title: Analysis and numerical simulations of a landfast ice model
summary: In this manuscript, we consider a common modeling framework for Arctic landfast ice based on the work of Lemieux et al. [27], which is designed for use in large-scale climate models. This approach extends the classical viscous-plastic sea-ice model introduced by Hibler [18], which remains the most widely used model for simulating large-scale sea-ice dynamics. In particular, landfast ice refers to sea-ice that is attached to the coastline or grounded and therefore exhibits nearly vanishing motion.
